name: BSP_TutorialHint_AdvanceBasicStep
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = *(00E198C4 + 0xA8) (the tutorial/hint screen owned by the mission object), no stack arguments, RET 0. NOT on the front-end path: the only OnMove call site is 004e522d inside the in-mission pause branch, guarded by that object's byte +8h. Body: clears its own bytes +8h and +9h, calls this+20h virtual +34h with 0, 004d94f0(game, 0), zeroes the float at +54h, stops two force-feedback effects through BSP_InputManager_GetSingleton slots +2FD0h and +0DE0h, reads the current hint id from the award tracker (004e1ca0 then 0068e5b0) and advances it one step: BASICPLANE->BASICPLANE2 (strcmp 00BF7FBF then a fresh 0xB byte buffer), and through the native-string comparison 00425850 BASICPLANE2->BASICPLANE3, BASICSHIP->BASICSHIP2, BASICSUB->BASICSUB2. It then calls 0068e420 and, when the id is non-empty, 00690fd0(tracker, &id, 0), whose body holds hints.missionhint and the HintSystem Lua strings. So it re-shows the next basic-training hint when the pause menu opens; the map note 'front-end button segment' is superseded.
